key_analysis.depth_gap: From depth-(K+1) 2-var agreement, exist_transfer_from_full_agree gives depth-K 3-var existential transfer. Need depth-(K+1). Gap is intrinsic: exist_transfer always loses 1 depth level.
key_analysis.nvar_transfer_circular: nvar_transfer_from_1var_agree at d=K+1 needs h_rvar at depth K+2 arity 2, which IS the goal.
key_analysis.correct_approach: Induction on d (NF depth) with universal arity r. 1-var agreement at depth d+1 for each env component. Witnesses via Prior-UZ (HasAttainedINF.first_occ with char_fn). Quantifier conditions by IH at depth d with env extended by [z,z'].
key_analysis.zone3_hard_case: When both cross_extend companions (w2 from h_t, w1 from h_x) are outside (t', x'), need to prove char_fn formula is realized in the interval. This is the mathematical content of the Prior-UZ/SZ axioms: every temporal formula realized on both sides of an interval has occurrences constrained by the boundary points' types.
key_analysis.ih_structure: IH at depth d with env [z,envM]/[z',envN] needs: (a) 1-var at d+1 for z/z' -- from char_fn construction via Prior-UZ giving depth-(d+1) 1-var match; (b) 1-var at d+1 for envM/envN -- weaken from depth d+2; (c) order matching -- from atom matching at depth d+1.
